findings.message: The data holds 2005 pause or null bursts in 2 runs, which carry no audio (IEC 61937-1 7.2 and 7.4); they are counted and not listed.

The data holds 6 data-bursts of IEC 61937 with AC-3 frames, as S/PDIF passthrough writes them, not samples; the fmt chunk describes the carrier (16 bits, 2 channels at 48000 Hz), and the stream is read as AC-3.
